name: Dependabot pnpm lockfile update

on:
  pull_request_target:
    types: [opened, synchronize]
    branches: [main]  # adjust if your default branch is different

jobs:
  update-lockfile:
    if: github.actor == 'dependabot[bot]'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Fetch Dependabot metadata
        id: dependabot
        uses: dependabot/fetch-metadata@v2
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Set up Node.js and pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 8
          cache: true

      - name: Install dependencies (update lockfile)
        run: pnpm install
        working-directory: ${{ steps.dependabot.outputs.directory || '.' }}

      - name: Check if pnpm-lock.yaml changed
        id: check_lockfile
        run: |
          if git diff --name-only pnpm-lock.yaml | grep -q pnpm-lock.yaml; then
            echo "changed=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "changed=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Commit updated lockfile
        if: steps.check_lockfile.outputs.changed == 'true'
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add pnpm-lock.yaml
          git commit -m "chore: update pnpm-lock.yaml for Dependabot"
          git push origin HEAD:${{ github.head_ref }}
